hook.say: Turkey has sea on three sides. Do you really know its coasts? Five questions, starting easy!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which sea lies along Türkiye's northern coast?
questions.say: Which sea lies along Turkey's northern coast?
questions.fact: The eastern Black Sea coast is the rainiest part of Türkiye.
questions.sayAnswer: The Black Sea! Its eastern coast is the rainiest part of Turkey.

questions.q: Which strait links the Aegean Sea to the Sea of Marmara?
questions.say: Which strait links the Aegean Sea to the Sea of Marmara?
questions.fact: In antiquity the Dardanelles were known as the Hellespont.
questions.sayAnswer: The Dardanelles! In ancient times they were known as the Hellespont.

questions.q: Which city is the tourism capital of the Turkish Riviera?
questions.say: Which city is the tourism capital of the Turkish Riviera?
questions.fact: Antalya is Türkiye's biggest international sea resort.
questions.sayAnswer: Antalya! It is Turkey's biggest international sea resort.

questions.q: The famous Blue Lagoon of Ölüdeniz is near which town?
questions.say: The famous Blue Lagoon of Uh-lu-deniz is near which town?
questions.fact: Ölüdeniz means Dead Sea, named for its calm waters.
questions.sayAnswer: Fet-hee-yeh! The lagoon's Turkish name means Dead Sea, because its waters are so calm.

questions.q: Who built Bodrum's seaside castle in the 15th century?
questions.say: Who built Bodrum's seaside castle in the 15th century?
questions.fact: The knights reused stones from the ancient Mausoleum of Halicarnassus.
questions.sayAnswer: The Knights of Saint John! They reused stones from the ancient Mausoleum of Halicarnassus.
